name: ds-vision-skill
release_notes: Preserved simultaneous racing across all four vision models.
Moved the race hot path to asynchronous HttpClient requests with no polling waits.
Reduced repeated serialization and enabled compact JSON output.
Added reproducible 0.4.1 -> 0.4.2 -> 0.5.0 benchmarks with methodology and raw Mock/Live data.
Added cmd.exe-safe setup and router launchers plus harness guidance for Zcode/Codex/Hermes wrappers.
